status: Preregistered; independent S2 tolerance review approved; implementation and execution not started.

acceptanceContract.requirement: Synthetic software parity for automatic and manual harvest payout under the same frozen model inputs, with harvest mass and replay invariants; A-07 overall remains UNVERIFIED.

classification: paired synthetic crop-model-v2 management-mode software regression; not a crop or model-accuracy benchmark
comparisonType: Within-version software invariant comparing automatic and single-manual harvest modes; not a model-candidate, reference-model, measured-output, calibration, or holdout comparison.

inputFixtureReferences.role: The existing two-request idempotency case remains separate; this parity fixture uses one manual request.

syntheticSetup.testLocation: src/lib/sim/model-inputs.test.ts, existing test titled runs the v2 reducer with complete frozen inputs and keeps empirical accuracy qualified

frozenParameters.thermal: Existing cropThermalParams entry is frozen by the test input; its crop/domain accuracy is not assessed here.

dailyEnvironment.weather: Deterministic synthetic sunnySeries; not observed or geographically resolved weather.

preManualControl.environmentPrefix: First 63 entries of the same frozen synthetic series, through dayIndex 62; all frozen model inputs and run configuration remain the same.
preManualControl.evaluationOrder: stepDay applies dated manual harvest interventions before the per-cell growth pass. Therefore the dayIndex 63 manual harvest reads the state after dayIndex 62 and before dayIndex 63 growth; the 63-entry prefix captures that payout input.
preManualControl.assertion: Reuse the existing synthetic test precision: dryMatterGPerM2 toBeCloseTo(252, 8); harvestReadyDay and biomassFrac exact.

expectedPairedInvariants.eventTiming: Automatic event at dayIndex 62 and single-manual event at the first eligible dayIndex 63; the one-day offset is intentional and event dates must not be compared as equal.
expectedPairedInvariants.eventSelection: Exactly one harvested event for cell 0,0 in each arm.
expectedPairedInvariants.payout: Each event is 0.007875 kg within the registered arithmetic bound; absolute automatic/manual payout difference is also bounded by that same value.
expectedPairedInvariants.summaries: Total and per-crop summaries are exactly 0.01 kg in each arm.
expectedPairedInvariants.replay: Repeated execution of each arm from identical frozen inputs and its exact environment series yields exactly equal events, final state, and summary.

toleranceReview.status: Approved by independent S2 review before test implementation; registered numerical bounds are unchanged.

metrics.tolerance: Absolute deviation and automatic/manual difference each <=1e-12 kg.
metrics.basis: Do not widen the existing 1e-12 kg arithmetic/conversion bound already preregistered for both V2-AUTO-DM-HARVEST-PAYOUT-SYNTHETIC-01 and V2-DUPLICATE-MANUAL-HARVEST-SYNTHETIC-01. This is double-precision payout arithmetic only, not crop error.

metrics.tolerance: Existing matcher toBeCloseTo(252, 8) g DM/m2; harvestReadyDay 62 and biomassFrac 1 exact.
metrics.basis: Reuses existing assertion precision for the same synthetic A-07 one-cell frozen run; this does not establish biological maturity or a measured dry-matter value.

metrics.tolerance: Exact day indices, dates, event count, cell, rounded total/per-crop summaries, and replay equality.
metrics.basis: These are deterministic software routing and aggregation invariants.

reproduction.command: npx vitest run src/lib/sim/model-inputs.test.ts -t "runs the v2 reducer with complete frozen inputs and keeps empirical accuracy qualified"
reproduction.status: Not run; preregistration tolerances are independently approved; implementation has not started.

assumptions: Add the paired assertion and single-manual arm within the existing v2 frozen-input test.
Keep the existing duplicate-manual suppression case separate and unchanged.
Do not change production equations or create new numeric tolerances.

sourceBoundary: No new source artifact or external value is introduced. Production and root parameters are synthetic test scaffolding; the thermal input's provenance is not validated by this regression.
acceptanceBoundary: Software evidence only. Crop accuracy, biological validity, measured-trial agreement, reference-model agreement, and predictive validity remain UNVERIFIED; A-07 and overall 02A remain UNVERIFIED.
